title: form_handler.get_value duplicates the already-imported application_handler.get_form_value with a trim-semantics fork
detail: application_handler is already imported and exposes an identical key_find helper that also trims. The local copy silently omits the trim, a drift hazard for the _question and _form_loaded_at reads.
recommended_fix: Delete form_handler.get_value; route its 3 call sites (lines 319, 353, 910) through application_handler.get_form_value. The trim is harmless for ids and epoch-ms, and removes the fork.
